main:1.text: It immediately follows the events of Jason Brody and his friends' vacation time at Rook Islands. The mission begins with video footage of the friend group's exciting vacation before zooming out revealing a captive Jason and Grant in a cage.

main:3.text: After unscrambling the signal from the radio tower, Dennis Rogers tells Jason Brody to gather plants and animal skins from the wildlife to better prepare for his trials on Rook Islands. Dennis points Jason to the Boar hunting grounds, south-east of Amanaki Village to gather materials for crafting. Dennis tells Jason to embrace his natural instincts to better cope with the trials of the island.

main:4.text: After crafting the medicine and equipment gathered from the Boar hunting grounds, Jason Brody receives a call from the phone he grabbed before escaping Vaas' Camp. The pirate who calls him speaks of a captured American girl (presumably Liza Snow) and that they are taking her to a nearby outpost. After crafting the new equipment from the nature materials, Jason receives a call on the stolen cell phone from a pirate.

main:5.text: After liberating an enemy outpost in a search to find Liza Snow, Jason has to make his way to Dr. Earnhardt's Mansion. After finding Daisy rescued there, Jason has to find mushrooms in an underwater cave to heal her from her ailments she acquired going there. Jason must make his way west to meet Dr. Earnhardt.

main:6.text: Jason must covertly kill three radio operators, acquire their intel, go to the Medusa's control room, and eliminate reinforcements who arrive after the Medusa's alarm is triggered. After killing them, Jason is called by Dennis. Dennis tells Jason to go to Amanaki Village as the Rakyat need Jason's help. The mission ends after the phone call.

main:7.text: The Rakyat learn of an impending attack against Amanaki Village, and enlist the help of Jason. Jason is tasked with destroying the pirates' weapons stash in a logging camp. Jason returns from sabotaging the Medusa, whereupon Dennis informs him that the Rakyat warriors have learned that Vaas is planning to use a large weapons cache to destroy Amanaki Village. He assigns Jason the task of destroying the weapons.

main:8.text: Using the intercepted communications from the Medusa, Jason sets out to find his friends in the prison camp at Sunset Cove (aka Pirate's Cove). However, his friends have been moved elsewhere and Jason is captured by the pirates. Following up on the message heard on the Medusa, Jason infiltrates Pirate Cove in an effort to save his friends.

main:9.text: Jason and Liza are taken to the abandoned Island Port Hotel by Vaas and his men, where they set the building on fire in an attempt to kill the pair. However, Jason wrangles free from his bonds and rescues his girlfriend. Together they escape Vaas's men in pursuit, and return to the cave under Dr. Earnhardt's Mansion.

main:10.text: Daisy, Liza, and Jason reunite in the cave under Dr. Earnhardt's Mansion. Then Daisy asks Jason to find a power head for the outboard motor. This mission is very easy as the power head is at the end of a cave near a flash light.

main:11.text: Jason visits Citra to seek the help of the Rakyat against Vaas's pirates. Citra asks Jason to retrieve something that has been lost, and invites him to drink a mixture, which causes him to pass out and fall into a dream. In the dream, Jason sees his friends, a man in white suit, a shanty town, and an Asian ceremonial knife.

main:12.text: Bad Side of Town is the twelfth mission of Far Cry 3. Jason goes to Badtown to investigate the man in the white suit from his dreams. Once found, Jason follows him to a shack in Badtown without being spotted. Jason arrives at Badtown and located the building from his hallucination. He enters and sees the man in the white suit. Jason quickly sits down to a game of poker for cover.

main:13.text: After meeting the man in the white suit, he introduces himself as Willis Huntley, a CIA agent, and agrees to help Jason rescue his friends. However, Jason must first destroy Hoyt's drug fields to help Willis. Willis introduces the Flamethrower, which Jason uses to destroy the crops. Jason arrives at Willis' shack where Willis had his discussion with Jason about his patriotic motives.

main:14.text: A Man Named Hoyt is the fourteenth mission of Far Cry 3. CIA Agent Willis Huntley informs Jason that someone in Beras Town has stolen a transportation manifest potentially containing information on Oliver's whereabouts from a man named Hoyt. Seeking information about his missing friend Jason travels to Beras Town where he rescues a Rook Islander by the name of Rongo from a death squad hired by Hoyt.

main:15.text: Saving Oliver is the fifteenth mission of Far Cry 3. After obtaining the shipping manifest, Jason catches up to the convoy carrying his friend, Oliver. When he is being transferred to helicopter at the fishery, Jason snipes the guards while Oliver makes a getaway. They hijack a boat and escape to the cave under Dr. Earnhardt's Mansion.

main:16.text: Jason finds a hit man named Buck who is holding his friend Keith. In exchange for Keith, Buck wants the Asian ceremonial dagger, the same one that Citra needs. Jason boards the Nostalgia to try to find the location of the knife, and instead finds an ancient compass. His intrusion on the ship is detected, which causes the Nostalgia to self-destruct and start sinking.

main:17.text: The ancient compass leads Jason to a Japanese WWII bunker. Inside, he finds his way to some old Chinese ruins, and retrieves another piece of the compass, though the knife still eludes him. You will also find the brown crocodile and the macaque.

main:18.text: The ancient compass leads Jason to an abandoned mining facility. Inside, he finds his way to some old Chinese ruins, and retrieves the third piece of the compass, though the knife still eludes him.

main:19.text: The ancient compass leads Jason to a cenote and a cave complex. Inside, he finds his way to some old Chinese ruins, and retrieves the Chinese dagger that Buck and Citra are looking for.

main:20.text: Jason brings the ancient Chinese knife to Buck and trades it for Keith. However, Buck refuses to let the two of them leave his property. Jason and Buck duel with their knives, at the end of which Jason manages to kill Buck. Then, he brings Keith back to Dr. Earnhardt's Mansion where the other friends are. Having retrieved the knife, Jason arrives at Buck's house.

main:21.text: Jason meets Citra and delivers the ancient Chinese knife that she is looking for. She tells Jason of a warrior that killed a giant, foreshadowing he would need to follow a similar path. Then, she dispatches Jason on a mission to rescue captured Rakyat warriors. Jason enters Citra's temple and hands her the ancient Chinese knife that she was looking for, the Silver Dragon.

main:22.text: Jason agrees to help the Rakyat set up an ambush in Churchtown in an attempt to hijack an APC carrying Rakyat prisoners. The leader of the mission hands over to Jason C4 explosives he has to plant over a fuel truck, to block the road and divert the enemies plans. Jason has to then climb a water tower to snipe and aid the warriors in combat, waiting for the signalling explosives to go off.

main:23.text: Jason has been captured by Vaas, who tries to kill Jason a second time by drowning him in a cenote. However, Jason escapes and follows the APC to a nearby fishing village. There, he hijacks a Helicopter to make a getaway, but the chopper is shot down by an RPG. Vaas arrives at the wreckage and shoots Jason point-blank in a third attempt to kill him.

main:24.text: Jason meets Citra in her temple, and she gives him a drink which causes Jason to enter his dream state. In the dream, he fights and defeats the Ink Monster, proving himself to be worthy of a true Rakyat warrior. Jason wakes up in the temple while being raped by Citra, and declares to the Rakyat  that he will lead them to victory over Vaas and Hoyt.

main:25.text: Jason infiltrates the island on which Vaas is based to seek vengeance for his friends and for the Rakyat. After fighting through hordes of pirates, he enters Vaas's warehouse, where he is ambushed by Vaas yet again. Vaas stabs Jason with a knife, causing him to fall into a dream state. In this dream sequence, Jason finds and kills Vaas, which appears to have the same consequences outside of the dream.

main:26.text: Jason meets with his friends in the cave under Dr. Earnhardt's mansion to inform them that he intends to stay on the Rook Islands, and the rest of them should take the boat back to the US. Jason wakes up in Citra's Temple after killing Vaas in the dream sequence. Citra informs him that Vaas is dead, and they plan their next move to kill Hoyt.

main:27.text: Jason calls Willis to request his help in taking down Hoyt Volker. Willis offers him a plane ride to the South Island. After getting to the airstrip, Willis and his plane are attacked by pirates. Jason defends Willis until he fixes the plane, and then together they fly south. Willis lends Jason a Wingsuit and Parachute as they part ways over South Island.

main:28.text: Three Blind Mice is the twenty-eighth mission of Far Cry 3. After landing on the Southern Island, Jason kills some nearby pirates and steals their truck, then drives to Thurston Town. There, he enters a poker game and meets Sam, whom Willis mentioned could help him with Hoyt.

main:29.text: Sam devises a plan to disguise Jason as one of the privateer recruits to be able to get close to Hoyt. Jason infiltrates a nearby recruit-training base, sneaks past numerous privateers and kills a privateer named Foster and steals his uniform. The objectives of the mission are to infiltrate the base and tentatively sneak past the guards while only utilising rocks and your camera.

main:30.text: Sam and Jason come up with a plan for Jason to gain access to Hoyt. They decide to kill three privateer captains who are planning to betray Hoyt and obtain a roll sheet of the traitors to give to Hoyt. However, after the assassinations, Jason comes away with only a meeting note instead of the roll sheet.

main:31.text: Sam and Jason go to Hoyt's drug fields and defuse the bombs that pirates have planted. Jason must protect Sam from pirate attacks as he works on the bombs.

main:32.text: Jason infiltrates the privateer camp in the gorge, hoping to find the roll sheet of the traitors. After spotting the roll sheet exchange bridge overlooking the gorge, acquires the sheet, and makes a getaway.

main:33.text: Jason, disguised as a new privateer recruit Foster, and Sam arrive at Hoyt's compound and try to convince Hoyt let Jason into his inner circle. Hoyt applauds Jason's work in getting the roll sheet of the traitors, and asks him to interrogate a prisoner in the basement. Unbeknownst to Jason, the prisoner turns out to be his younger brother Riley.

main:34.text: In order to destroy Hoyt's organization, Sam and Jason devise a plan to destroy their satellite communication dish near the north-western region of the Southern Island. Jason kills the guards, blows through the bunker, and plants explosives on the dish. Then, Sam comes in a helicopter to pick him up. Once airborne, Jason triggers the explosives and destroys the communication dish.

main:35.text: To further sabotage Hoyt's organization, Sam and Jason go to the fuel depot and plant explosives on the pipelines and control room.

main:36.text: Accepting this mission will lock out all open world features (fast travel, side quests, trials, shops, etc) until the final mission, Hard Choices, is complete. Sam and Jason go to Hoyt's mansion to play poker, with a intention to kill Hoyt and rescue Riley. Unfortunately, their plan fails, as Hoyt had a different plan of his own, killing Sam and forcing Jason to play a futile game of poker.

main:37.text: During the previous knife fight, Hoyt reveals to Jason that Riley is at the airstrip and will be flown out imminently. After defeating Hoyt, Jason battles through the Compound and races to the airstrip within 12 minutes. He finds his brother in a holding cell and frees him. Together they commandeer a helicopter to make their escape, with the last of Hoyt's mercenaries in hot pursuit.

main:38.text: Riley and Jason land their helicopter near Dr. Earnhardt's Mansion, hoping to meet their friends. However, the mansion has been ransacked and everyone is gone. Jason finds a critically injured Dr. Earnhardt, who informs him with his last breath that the Rakyat had kidnapped Jason's friends. Confused, Jason and Riley fly to Citra's Temple to learn their fate.

main:39.text: The mission begins as Jason exits the helicopter that he and Riley used to escape the Privateers. The brothers arrive at Citra's Temple after Dr. Earnhardt informed them that Jason's other friends had been kidnapped by the Rakyat. Upon entering, Rakyat warriors are seen taking Riley away. Jason asks Citra where Riley is being taken. Upon turning to Citra, she blows a glowing dust onto Jason.
